text.tspan: CTR turns a block cipher into a stream cipher — but requires external authentication

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: How block ciphers transform into stream or authenticated modes

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: AES-CTR

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Encrypts (Nonce ‖ counter) to produce keystream S.
Ciphertext is C = P ⊕ S. No padding needed.
No integrity — tampering decrypts without error.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Malleable: C[i] ⊕ Δ = P[i] ⊕ Δ
Reused Nonce ⇒ C₁ ⊕ C₂ = P₁ ⊕ P₂

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: ⚠ Confidentiality only — needs a MAC

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: AES-CBC

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: XORs each plaintext block with previous ciphertext.
First block XORs random IV. Requires padding.
Spread is bounded to 2 blocks. No AEAD tag (padding-oracle risk).

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Tamper randomizes that block; the
same bits flip in the next block

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: ⚠ Unauthenticated (needs MAC)

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: AES-GCM

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: CTR keystream encryption + a GHASH-based tag
computed over ciphertext and associated data.
Security holds only while nonces never repeat.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: AEAD: 1-bit tamper rejects ciphertext
before decryption completes

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: ✔ Authenticated (requires unique nonces)

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Scope: educational comparison of mode properties. CBC spread per NIST SP 800-38A App. D; GCM nonce limits per SP 800-38D §8.
